text.description_html:
LCN 4310ME Fire Safety Door Closer

The LCN 4310ME SENTRONIC is a heavy duty, electrically controlled closer/holder designed to provide infinitely adjustable hold-open for fire and smoke barrier doors. Door is held open until current interruption releases mechanism and the door closes. Single lever (track) arm closer is specifically designed for interior doors.

The LCN 4310ME series closer shipped with a 24V or 120V cylinder on a mounting plate, metal cover, Swing-Free arm, track, track roller, and wood and machine screw pack. It is UL listed for smoke barrier or labeled fire doors. cUL listed for self-closing doors without hold open. Tested and certified under ANSI Standard A156.15. Conforms to life safety code, NFPA 101. Sized #4 cylinder for Interior Doors up to 4'0".

Functions as a full rack and pinion closer when hold-open is not engaged or current is interrupted. Built-in “On/Off” switch controls hold-open function and the Swing-Free arm allows door to be moved without door closer resistance.

Features and Specifications for LCN 4314ME Fire Safety Door Closer

  • Door Width: Interior Door 36" - 48"
  • Maximum Opening: 180º
  • Mounting: Pull Side
  • Handed
  • Interfaces with Alarm Systems
  • Certified ANSI Standard A156.15
  • Conforms to NFPA 101
  • UL Listed
  • cUL Listed for Self-Closing Doors
  • LCN 4310ME Information (PDF)

The LCN 4314ME is available in 3 different finish colors with optional 120V or 24V cylinder.

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this door closer:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
